title: International Klein Blue (If You Can Find It)
summary: A pigment-less monochrome whose only paint is a colour the viewer must steal from elsewhere on the screen.
mechanism: The browser's native EyeDropper API, whose sole function is to sample a pixel from anywhere outside the artwork, floods the canvas with appropriated colour; RAM only, no storage or network.
references: EyeDropper API (WICG) as web-native found object
